what: From integrate-tooling (01073, the part integrate gave proof): v2 refuses every unit while BLAZE_BACKEND or BLAZE_OPT is set (crates/hir-ty-codegen/v2/backend.rs, CHANGES_CODE) and picks the backend by the profile (opt-level 0-1 Cranelift, the rest LLVM). (1) harness/v2/engine.py: `Engine.env` sets BLAZE_BACKEND=self.spec.backend for every command (line ~427), BLAZE_OPT=2 and BLAZE_EMIT=fast for llvm (~429), and BLAZE_CACHE (v2's store is <home>/v2/store whatever it says); line ~409 and corpus.py:772 still describe BLAZE_BACKEND=llvm. Remove them, never scrub-and-ignore: an engine's backend becomes a profile (as fuzz/store.py and fuzz/edits.py take `profiles`, and bench.py's BACKENDS is now {"cranelift": (), "llvm": ("--release",)}). (2) blaze_cli changed under engine.py: `how_built` now returns "daemon" when the build printed cargo's `Finished` line (v2 prints cargo's lines, never `[blaze]`) and "failed: <first error>" otherwise; `by_rustc` is gone (no v2 output can tell a cargo build; norustc.py holds that). `Engine.not_blazes` (~489-498) still compares with "cargo" and "unchanged" and calls blaze_cli.by_rustc (unreachable now, but pyright will flag it), and a refused build now reads as "failed: ..." where it read "cargo". (3) harness/v2/tightmemory.py: BLAZE_MEMORY_BUDGET is read by no v2 crate, so its budget sets nothing.
